deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 17% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 33% last year; 18%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 82% (3 years ago 51%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $82 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 61% (3 years ago 49%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $2.7B, down 4% from a year ago — about 10% of the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $2.4B, down 8% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 18%/yr over 3 years and 11%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 37% vs a 5-year range of 27–37% (median 31%): near the top of a fairly narrow range.
deeper.margin_position: near the top of a fairly narrow range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $5.2B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($3.9B buybacks + $1.3B dividends) = 1.9% of the company's market value. Share count down 1.1% from a year ago (buybacks outpacing stock pay).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $12.24, up 20% in 90 days (up 4% in the last 30); 15 analysts raised, 7 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $9.65, up 17% in 90 days (up 2% in the last 30); 19 analysts raised, 8 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By product, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Systems revenue 70% of sales, up 62%; Customer support-related revenue and other 30% of sales, up 40%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +75% vs a year ago · $6.73 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 75% vs sales 54% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 6%: beating is now expected, so a small beat may not lift the stock.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +54% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $26.1B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 54% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 24% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $37 of operating profit, up from $33 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: Only 77% of reported profit became spare cash, usually because of heavy investment; worth watching.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 33× last year's profit (higher than 70% of the last 5 years); only 18× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 27; analysts expect EPS of $2.35, up 85% from a year ago. It usually moves about 7% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is up 20% in 90 days (15 raised, 7 cut lately): forecasts are moving up fast.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
